description: Security remediation tasks for AI-Smart-LMS. Organized by severity: mandatory (critical), potential (high), optional (medium-low). Each task addresses specific CWE vulnerabilities and CVEs identified in the security assessment.

tasks.description: Remediate critical CVE vulnerabilities in Spring Boot and MySQL dependencies
tasks.reason: Three high-severity CVEs (CVE-2026-22733, CVE-2026-40972, CVE-2023-22102) require immediate patching to prevent authentication bypass, timing attacks, and connector takeover vulnerabilities.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-actuator to 4.0.4 or later (from 2.7.18). Upgrade org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-devtools to 4.0.6 or later (from 2.7.18). Upgrade com.mysql:mysql-connector-j to 8.2.0 or later (from 8.0.33). Update pom.xml with new versions. Verify all project dependencies are compatible with upgraded versions. Run full build and unit tests to ensure no breaking changes.

tasks.description: Implement file upload validation and restrict dangerous file types
tasks.reason: CWE-434: FileStorageService accepts any file extension without validation. Attackers can upload executable files (.exe, .sh, .bat, .jar) that may be automatically processed or executed.
tasks.requirements: Add whitelist-based file type validation in FileStorageService.storeFile(). Restrict upload to safe extensions: .pdf, .doc, .docx, .xls, .xlsx, .ppt, .pptx, .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .mp4, .avi, .mov. Reject dangerous types: .exe, .sh, .bat, .jar, .dll, .com, .scr, .msi, .app, .bin. Implement MIME type validation using Apache Tika or similar. Store uploaded files with randomized names (UUID-based). Validate file size limits. Add logging for rejected uploads.

tasks.description: Remove hard-coded passwords, cryptographic keys, and default credentials
tasks.reason: CWE-259, CWE-321, CWE-798: Multiple hard-coded credentials found: (1) Database password 'Rocky.2004#' in application.properties; (2) JWT secret key in JwtService.java; (3) Default admin/instructor credentials in DataSeeder.java. This violates OWASP A02:2021 - Cryptographic Failures.
tasks.requirements: Move database password from application.properties to environment variables or AWS Secrets Manager. Externalize JWT secret key to environment variables with minimum 32-character random value. Remove default credentials from DataSeeder.java; use environment-based initialization. Use Spring Cloud Config or HashiCorp Vault for secrets management in production. Update test configurations to use separate test credentials. Document credential management strategy. For all three areas: (1) database: read spring.datasource.password from env 'DB_PASSWORD'; (2) JWT: read from env 'JWT_SECRET_KEY'; (3) default accounts: read from env 'ADMIN_EMAIL', 'ADMIN_PASSWORD', 'TEACHER_PASSWORD'.

tasks.description: Implement path traversal prevention in FileStorageService
tasks.reason: CWE-22, CWE-23, CWE-36: FileStorageService.getFilePath() allows path traversal attacks using '../', absolute paths, or symbolic links. normalize() alone is insufficient.
tasks.requirements: Implement strict path validation in getFilePath(): (1) Validate that resolved path starts with uploadDir base path using startsWith() check; (2) Reject paths containing '..', './../../', or any relative traversal sequences; (3) Reject absolute paths (starting with / or drive letters); (4) Use Files.isSymbolicLink() check to prevent symlink traversal; (5) Use canonical path comparison to detect bypasses; (6) Throw SecurityException on violation. Test with malicious inputs: '../../../etc/passwd', '/etc/passwd', 'file://etc/passwd', symlink paths. Add comprehensive unit tests for path traversal scenarios.

tasks.description: Remediate Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in InstructorAITools component
tasks.reason: CWE-79: InstructorAITools.jsx uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML with minimal sanitization. Unescaped AI response content can execute malicious JavaScript in user browsers.
tasks.requirements: Remove dangerouslySetInnerHTML usage from line 119-124 in InstructorAITools.jsx. Implement proper HTML sanitization using DOMPurify library. Parse AI response safely: (1) use DOMPurify.sanitize() for markdown-generated HTML; (2) escape all untrusted content; (3) use React's built-in JSX escaping for text rendering. Convert markdown formatting (** bold **, __ italic __) to React components instead of HTML. Test with OWASP XSS payloads:

tasks.description: Implement comprehensive security logging for authentication and access control events
tasks.reason: CWE-778: AuthService.login() does not log authentication failures. Missing logs prevent detection of brute force attacks, unauthorized access attempts, and forensic analysis of security incidents.
tasks.requirements: Add logging to AuthService.login() method (lines 142-180): (1) Log successful login attempts with user email, timestamp, IP address; (2) Log failed authentication with reason (invalid email, wrong password, inactive account); (3) Log suspicious patterns (rapid login failures = brute force); (4) Include request metadata (User-Agent, IP). Implement log levels: WARN for failed attempts, INFO for success, ERROR for system failures. Use SLF4J/Logback. Configure separate security audit log file. Do NOT log passwords or sensitive data. Set log retention policy (90 days minimum). Test with failed login scenarios.

tasks.description: Implement proper resource cleanup and lifecycle management
tasks.reason: CWE-772, CWE-775: Window handles (window.open()) and DOM elements are created but never released. This causes resource leaks and memory bloat. Proper cleanup is essential for long-running browser sessions.
tasks.requirements: In CertificateGenerator.jsx: (1) Window at line 154: Capture window reference, close on component unmount using useEffect cleanup; (2) DOM elements at lines 13, 145: Use React refs or controlled DOM lifecycle; (3) Implement proper cleanup in useEffect(() => { ... return () => { cleanup } }). For browser resources: use AbortController for fetch operations, properly close window handles. For DOM: avoid creating elements in useState, manage DOM node lifecycle with useRef. Test with React DevTools Profiler to verify cleanup on unmount. Verify no memory leaks in browser DevTools.

tasks.description: Refactor localStorage access to use centralized data manager component
tasks.reason: CWE-1057: Direct localStorage operations scattered across multiple files (gamification.js, LearningHeatmap.jsx, flashcards.js, StudentSidebar.jsx, AdminSidebar.jsx, AdminRoles.jsx). This violates centralized data management pattern and creates maintainability, consistency, and security issues.
tasks.requirements: Create centralized DataManager component/service in src/services/DataManager.js with unified API: (1) getStoredData(key), setStoredData(key, value), removeStoredData(key), clearAllData(); (2) Implement data validation and sanitization at entry point; (3) Add encryption for sensitive data (JWT tokens); (4) Implement audit logging for data access. Replace all direct localStorage calls: gamification.js lines 34-47, LearningHeatmap.jsx lines 7,14, api.js line 12, flashcards.js line 17. Update StudentSidebar.jsx and AdminSidebar.jsx to use DataManager. Add data versioning/schema validation. Test data consistency across components.

tasks.description: Implement numeric type conversion validation and input bounds checking
tasks.reason: CWE-681: Multiple instances of unsafe numeric type conversions from untrusted input without validation. Examples: api.js line 421 (count), AdminSemesters.jsx line 106 (semester ID), InstructorCourseCreate.jsx line 91 (course price). Invalid numeric values cause unexpected behaviors or security issues.
tasks.requirements: Implement helper function for safe numeric conversion: (1) Validate input is numeric string; (2) Check range bounds (min/max values); (3) Handle overflow/underflow; (4) Throw clear error on invalid input. In api.js line 421: validate count is 0-1000, integer; In AdminSemesters.jsx line 106: validate semester ID is positive integer < 2^31; In InstructorCourseCreate.jsx line 91: validate price is 0-999999.99, two decimals. Add server-side validation for all numeric inputs. Use input validation library (e.g., validator.js). Test with edge cases: -1, 0, max int, float values, NaN, infinity.

tasks.description: Create comprehensive security testing suite and integrate into CI/CD pipeline
tasks.reason: Ensure all security remediations are validated through automated testing. Prevent regression of security vulnerabilities and catch new issues early.
tasks.requirements: Create security test suite: (1) Unit tests for path traversal scenarios; (2) Unit tests for file upload validation; (3) Integration tests for credential management; (4) XSS payload tests; (5) Brute force attack simulation; (6) Resource cleanup verification; (7) Data access pattern conformance tests. Use security testing libraries (OWASP ZAP for automated scanning). Integrate SAST tool (SonarQube) into build pipeline. Configure pre-commit hooks for security checks. Add security scanning to CI/CD workflow. Maintain minimum 90% code coverage for security-related code.
